limits: Isolated macOS PTY native read_password, six finite dummy lines; no real secrets.
31 positive fixed 128-call samples, explicit sample target 0. No calibrated 20ms or maximum-speed claim. Cold first call includes producer startup and is retained separately.
Exact helper call counts prefeed 4070 Rust /4090 Go lines for each timing child (first+100 warm+31 samples+allocation passes); output-only RSS child feeds one line.
A finite writer may block on the real kernel input queue for long lines; this is native queue/read latency, not a pure parser benchmark. Native data and configured state are checked.
Descriptor acquisition and initial outer capture are outside samples; current capture/non-echo transition/read/allocation/current restore are included.
Three alternating cohorts; no build, tests, Miri, LLVM or downloads overlap ordinary timings. Whole-process RSS includes language startup/runtime, not per-operation peak memory.
